author: Unity
description:
Alyssa Kollgaard, COO of Akupara Games, shares an indie publisher's perspective on overcoming the biggest challenges in games today: discoverability and the attention economy.

Learn how Akupara thinks about games made for niche audiences, why this publisher prioritizes Unity projects, and their key takeaways from reviving the decade-old survival classic, Rain World, and bringing it to new platforms.

Explore the Akupara Games catalog: https://www.akuparagames.com/ 

More from Alyssa Kollgaard in the 2026 Unity Game Development Report: https://on.unity.com/2026GameDevReport
